naive.definition: one target-hidden response using only the trivial baseline prompt; no LoopGym system prompt, inference framework, pruning, or reroll

loopgym_r1_no_houdini.definition: one target-hidden response using the LoopGym generation prompt; no candidate pruning or reroll

loopgym_r1_houdini.definition: one target-hidden response using the LoopGym generation prompt, followed by Frama-C/WP Houdini

loopgym_r4_houdini.definition: four target-hidden responses per attempt; union then Frama-C/WP Houdini

autospec.definition: native AutoSpec one-shot pipeline on a target-hidden source

clause2inv.definition: native Clause2Inv generate-combine-check pipeline with target-free pre/transition checks

sespec.definition: native SESpec default pipeline on a target-hidden source

common_judge.source: untouched original program with generated loop invariants inserted
common_judge.success: syntax valid, every generated invariant inductive, and every original assertion goal proved

negative_rejection.score: fraction of synthetic negative trace groups rejected by standalone Houdini-surviving generated invariants
negative_rejection.no_negative_policy: negative_rejection_score is null; binary_frama_c_validation is recorded separately
